run_audio_visual_speaker_separation: run the audio-visual speaker separation pipeline on real video with mouth ROI and facial track data
test_get_separated_audio: test the get_separated_audio function that uses lipreading, facial, and UNet networks to separate audio from spectrogram
build_lipreading_network: build a lipreading network using ModelBuilder with config path, weights, and feature extraction options
build_facial_attributes_network: build a facial attributes network using ModelBuilder with pool type, feature dimension, and weights
normalize_and_clip_audio: normalize audio samples by RMS level and clip values to the range [-1, 1]
